title: Evolve Where It Matters: Coverage-Guided Self-Evolution of Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2611.25429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills package procedural knowledge as natural-language instructions, and a skill helps only when its instructions are correct and properly followed by the agent. Self-evolving agents revise their own skills from the runs they make, but existing methods judge each run as a whole, by its outcome or by where it went wrong, and cannot tell whether a failure comes from a wrong instruction or from one the agent did not follow. Instruction-level coverage was introduced to test skills and labels each instruction of a run as follow, not-follow, or not covered, which separates these causes. We leverage it for skill self-evolution with SkillPlumber, a framework in which an agent evolves its own skills where coverage shows they fall short. translated_title: 在关键之处进化：覆盖率引导的智能体技能自我进化
translated_abstract: 智能体技能将程序性知识打包为自然语言指令，只有当指令本身正确且被智能体恰当遵循时，技能才能发挥作用。自进化智能体会根据自身的运行记录来修订技能，但现有方法将每次运行作为一个整体来评判——依据其结果或出错的位置——无法区分失败究竟是源于指令本身错误，还是源于智能体没有遵循指令。指令级覆盖率最初被引入用于测试技能，它将一次运行中的每条指令标记为“遵循”、“未遵循”或“未覆盖”，从而区分了上述两类失败原因。我们利用这一机制实现技能自我进化，提出了 SkillPlumber——一个让智能体在覆盖率显示技能不足之处进行自我进化的框架。一个持久的根因分析智能体将每个标签转化为修订问题，并在下一次运行中检验每项修订，同时一个维护者智能体将跨任务的调查结果提炼为共享策略。
tldr: 提出了 SkillPlumber 框架，利用指令级覆盖率标注区分失败源于指令错误还是未遵循指令，使智能体能够只在技能真正不足之处进行针对性的自我进化。
en_tdlr: SkillPlumber leverages instruction-level coverage labels to distinguish whether failures stem from wrong instructions or from un-followed ones, enabling agents to self-evolve their skills precisely where coverage shows they fall short.
